title.en: State the three central problems of an economy
Classify real decisions by the central problem they answer

say.en: Should India make more tractors or more mobile phones? Should a factory use more workers or more machines? And who gets the goods once they are made? In this lesson: State the three central problems of an economy.
Explain labour-intensive and capital-intensive techniques.
Classify real decisions by the central problem they answer.

body.en: Because resources are scarce, every economy faces three *central problems*. What to produce and in what quantities: more food, cloth, houses, defence goods or education? How to produce: which combination of resources and which technique to use? For whom to produce: how is the output distributed among the people of the economy?
body.kn: ಅಭಾವದ ಕಾರಣ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅರ್ಥವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಗೆ ಮೂರು ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳಿವೆ: ಏನನ್ನು ಉತ್ಪಾದಿಸಬೇಕು, ಹೇಗೆ ಉತ್ಪಾದಿಸಬೇಕು ಮತ್ತು ಯಾರಿಗಾಗಿ ಉತ್ಪಾದಿಸಬೇಕು.

title.en: On the board: Three central problems

say.en: Scarcity leaves every economy with three central problems.
What to produce, how much: hospitals or flyovers? How to produce: which technique?
For whom: who gets the output, for example subsidised rice for poor families.
Labour-intensive methods use more workers; capital-intensive methods use more machines.
India has many workers and little capital, so it often prefers labour-intensive methods that create jobs.

explanation.en: Because resources are scarce, every economy must choose what to produce, which technique to use, and how to distribute the output among its people.

body.en: A *technique* is labour-intensive if it uses relatively more labour, and capital-intensive if it uses relatively more machines. Each good can usually be made by more than one technique. A country with many workers and little capital, like India, often prefers labour-intensive methods for many goods, which also creates jobs.
body.kn: ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಶ್ರಮ ಬಳಸುವ ತಂತ್ರ ಶ್ರಮ-ಪ್ರಧಾನ; ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಯಂತ್ರ ಬಳಸುವ ತಂತ್ರ ಬಂಡವಾಳ-ಪ್ರಧಾನ. ಶ್ರಮ ಹೇರಳವಾಗಿರುವ ಭಾರತದಂತಹ ದೇಶ ಅನೇಕ ಸರಕುಗಳಿಗೆ ಶ್ರಮ-ಪ್ರಧಾನ ತಂತ್ರವನ್ನು ಆರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
